title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs quickstart
author: Jordan Lee
description: Motivation: provide curated RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates and tool-calling examples to accelerate developer onboarding and ensure consistent quality across quickstarts. This PR adds a docs quickstart page, three ready-to-use agent templates (faq-bot, support-tickets, sales-assistant), and TypeScript + Python sample apps that demonstrate structured tool-calling and secure connector wiring. Changes: - docs/quickstarts/rag-agent-quickstart.md: new quickstart that walks through creating an index, wiring Redwood connectors, and deploying an agent to the playground with code snippets. - examples/rag/faq-bot/: TS + Python samples and Dockerfile for local testing. - examples/rag/support-tickets/: template integrating a ticketing tool (mock) showing multi-step tool calls and error handling. - examples/rag/sales-assistant/: tool-calling example demonstrating product catalog lookup + quote generation with function outputs. - docs/snippets/: moved and normalized code snippets for consistency with docs site renderers. - images/diagrams/rag-flow.png: new architecture diagram. Checklist: [x] Quickstart content drafted and reviewed by PM; [x] Examples include README + minimal test harness; [x] CI linting & docs build pass locally; [x] Security review for connector examples (no secrets checked in). Notes: kept example connectors as local mocks; instructions include KMS/HSM integration pointers for Private deployments. Related: ENG-4821 (RAG templates), PM-197 (quickstart campaign). Release impact: docs-only, no runtime behavior changes.
